title: Detailed botanical illustration of pitcher plants
summary: A colorful botanical illustration depicts multiple pitcher plants with intricate red, pink, orange, and green pitchers and curling vines. The composition is arranged centrally on a cream-colored background with text printed at the top and bottom edges. The palette features vibrant natural tones with fine detailing on the leaves and traps.

title: Botanical illustration of a plant root system
summary: A detailed botanical illustration shows the above-ground foliage and extensive underground root system of a leafy plant. The drawing is rendered in black and white pencil on a plain background, with a depth scale marked in centimeters along the left side. Hand-written text appears in the upper left corner, reading Cynara scolymus, Artichoke, abb. 152.

title: Botanical illustration of plant root system
summary: A detailed botanical diagram illustrates a plant with its leafy stem above ground and an extensive root system spreading below. The pencil drawing is set against a plain background with depth markers labeled along the left vertical axis. Handwritten text appears in the upper left corner.

title: Botanical illustration of various orchid species
summary: A detailed botanical illustration features a dense arrangement of diverse orchid species in full bloom. The lithograph displays a rich palette of pinks, whites, deep maroons, yellows, and browns against a muted beige and grey background. Text at the top reads Haeckel, Kunstformen der Natur and Tafel 74 - Cypripedium, while text at the bottom reads Orchideae. - Venusblumen.

title: Botanical illustration of oranges and leaves
summary: A detailed botanical illustration features a whole orange with green leaves, a sliced orange showing internal segments, and another peeled orange half. The image is rendered with a stippled dot pattern in vibrant yellow, orange, and green against a light blue background. Handwritten text reading "62.17" and "L.C. Transfer 1921" appears in the upper area.
